The evaluation metric is "Exact Match". This metric is the average of the per-example exact match score for a dataset. The per-example exact match score is either 0 or 1; 1 if the model's answer is exactly the same as the text of any ground truth answer after lower-casing, removing punctuation, and normalizing spaces; otherwise 0.
